units.name: College of Business
units.evidence: The official full graduate panel names College of Business, hosting MBA concentrations including Engineering Management and a Supply Chain Management certificate. The original employer advertisement explicitly locates Operations Management teaching/research in this college and reports the position to its dean. The actual college is retained, not an invented OM department.

decisions.reason: Original official employer advertisement identifies Operations Management as the faculty position/teaching field within College of Business, reporting directly to the dean. Current official college award inventory confirms actual college; no separate OM department established.

sources.note: Read full current Graduate Studies page and every expanded programme description. Some first rapid clicks did not complete expansion; subsequently individually opened/read Counselor Education, Educational Leadership, Special Education and Teacher Leadership, along with previously read MBA, Early Intervention, Nursing, Teaching and Sport Administration. No attempted click counted as a completed panel read. MBA includes Engineering Management concentration and SCM certificate; Educational Leadership explicitly MSE/EdS.

Opened complete institutional degree list and expanded Graduate, then read entire graduate degree and certificate panel across all three colleges, every subfield and award/certificate entry. No doctoral award listed. Engineering Management is MBA concentration, SCM a graduate certificate.

Read complete original employer-posted Assistant Professor of Operations Management advertisement. Position belongs to College of Business, reports to college dean, teaches undergraduate/graduate OM/SCM/logistics and conducts applied research. No separately constituted Operations Management department named. Applicant doctorate requirement not institutional award evidence. No application/outreach performed.

limitations: Operations Management is a verified college teaching/research field, not an independently evidenced department. The actual College of Business is retained as host.

The doctorate demanded of a faculty applicant does not establish a Henderson PhD. Full current graduate inventory shows master’s, specialist and certificate provision only; no historical or permanent absence claim.
